property_summary: Only an admin can successfully call newEmergencyOracle; anyone else's call reverts.
A call to newEmergencyOracle reverts exactly when the caller is not an admin.

The owner of the deployed EmergencyOracle should be identical to the msg.sender of newEmergencyOracle call. The bug passes address(0) instead, so the oracle's owner is the zero address, violating the property for any caller other than address(0).

The owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle contract should equal the caller of newEmergencyOracle. The bug passes address(0) to the EmergencyOracle constructor, so the owner of the deployed oracle is address(0) instead of the caller.
For any non-zero caller, the owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle must equal the caller; the bug passes address(0) as owner, so the oracle's owner is address(0), violating the invariant.
